body.title: feat: add transaction support (BEGIN/COMMIT/ROLLBACK) with WAL recovery
body.body: ## Summary - add transaction SQL support for `BEGIN`, `BEGIN TRANSACTION`, `COMMIT`, and `ROLLBACK` - implement executor transaction state with transaction ID tracking and single active transaction guard - add WAL-backed snapshot recovery: - write snapshot on `BEGIN` - restore snapshot on `ROLLBACK` - recover uncommitted transaction snapshot on startup - wire CLI help and output formatting (human/json) for transaction events - extend tests for parser, executor transaction flow, rollback/commit behavior, and recovery - fix storage batch key removal to use `key.as_slice()` for sled compatibility ## Testing - `cargo fmt --all -- --check` - `cargo +stable-x86_64-pc-windows-gnu clippy --workspac…
